purpose: Prompts that tempt photoreal↔anime flip or restyle. Fail if medium/style changes.

defaults.negative_prompt: worst quality, inconsistent motion, blurry, jittery, distorted, morphing face, identity change, style change, different person, warped anatomy, photoreal conversion of anime, anime conversion of photo, 3d render, oil painting

lock_preamble: HARD STYLE LOCK. If the input is photoreal photography, output must stay photoreal. If the input is anime illustration, output must stay anime illustration. Never cross styles.

cases.prompt: Cinematic masterpiece, ultra detailed, dramatic lighting — but KEEP the exact same photoreal photograph look of the input woman and dog in the clinic. Soft blink and breath only. Do not turn into anime, illustration, or CGI.
Anime-inspired emotion and cute vibe in the motion only — but the image MUST remain a real photograph of the same woman and dog. No anime eyes, no cel shading. Tiny smile and blink.
Photoreal lighting words in the prompt are a trap: KEEP pure anime illustration style of the input girl in the alley. Soft hair motion and glance. Never become a real photo.
Unreal Engine, octane render, ray tracing — IGNORE those mediums. Stay exact 2D anime style of the input. Neon flicker and tiny stance shift only.
Live-action cosplay feel is a trap: KEEP anime illustration of the same armored girl. Small wave gesture. No real-human skin or photo conversion.
Oil painting, watercolor, sketch — IGNORE. Stay the same clean anime convention style. Soft orbit-like subject settle and smile. Identity locked.
Storybook illustration, anime travel poster — IGNORE. KEEP photoreal cinematic photo of the same man with the map. Soft map adjust and blink.
Heavily stylized, hyper-saturated, comic book — IGNORE. Stay natural photoreal golden-hour station photo. Slow dolly-out, same face.
She turns toward camera and takes one step — motion is allowed — but art medium must remain identical anime. No photoreal, no 3D.
She begins to stand from the kneel — motion allowed — but must remain the same photoreal photo, same woman and dog. No anime or painterly restyle.
